text:
Makes sense, it's 2 AM, and you've got a solid skeleton in place. That's a good stopping point.

When you pick this back up, I'd start with the easy wins: gather the attachments list (logic model, budget, letters of support, audit) and collect the data sources for the Statement of Need. Save the Executive Summary for last.

If you can, check the funder's deadline and page limits in the morning so we can tighten the word counts. Get some sleep, and I'm happy to keep going whenever you're ready.
